title: Isolation, Culturing, and Cryopreservation of Endozoicomonas from Reef-Building Corals
author: Claudia Pogoreutz
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.t2aeqae

steps.title: Collect coral fragments and record data
steps.instruction: Collect finger-sized coral fragment(s) in a sterile zip‑lock bag and note sampling conditions (site, depth, habitat).

steps.title: Maintain or process fragments promptly
steps.instruction: Process coral fragment(s) immediately; if not possible, keep them at ambient reef water temperature (28 °C, salinity 40 PSU) in a flow‑through aquarium or in a closed aquarium with daily water exchange.

substeps.instruction: Otherwise, store at 28 °C, 40 PSU in flow‑through or closed system with daily water exchange.

steps.title: Generate tissue slurry with AFSW
steps.instruction: Blast tissue off the coral skeleton using an air gun and autoclaved filtered seawater (AFSW; Whatman, 0.22 µm) to obtain a coral tissue slurry for inoculation.

steps.title: Homogenize tissue slurry
steps.instruction: Homogenize up to 15 ml of the tissue slurry per finger‑sized fragment for 30 seconds (e.g., using an IKA UltraTurrax).

steps.title: Plate slurry on Marine Agar
steps.instruction: Plate 50 µl of the slurry undiluted and in a 1:10 dilution onto Marine Agar 2216 (MA; BD Difco) in triplicate, incubate at 23 °C for 4 days, then isolate single colonies for purification.

substeps.instruction: Plate 50 µl undiluted slurry onto MA.
Plate 50 µl of a 1:10 dilution onto MA.
Select single colonies for subsequent purification.

steps.title: Purify colonies and verify identity
steps.instruction: Perform at least two clean passages of the isolated colonies and confirm their identity by Sanger sequencing.

substeps.instruction: Carry out a minimum of two clean passages.

steps.title: Cultivate in Marine Broth
steps.instruction: Inoculate 8 ml Marine Broth 2216 (MB; BD Difco) with a 10 µl loop of cells from purified colonies, close the tube, vortex, and incubate with constant motion (~60 rpm) at 25 °C for 48 hours.

substeps.instruction: Add a 10 µl loop of purified cells to 8 ml MB.
Incubate at 25 °C with ~60 rpm shaking for 48 h.

steps.title: Cryopreserve bacterial culture
steps.instruction: Prepare a 20 % (v/v) glycerol suspension of the culture in MB, aliquot, snap‑freeze, and store at –80 °C or –140 °C.

substeps.instruction: Mix culture with glycerol to achieve 20 % (v/v) glycerol in MB.
Aliquot the suspension into suitable cryovials.
